title: Cactus Jack survives Vader
summary: Cactus Jack’s willingness to absorb punishment turns him into a sympathetic opponent for Vader. A brutal television series, an ill-fitting amnesia angle and a Texas Death Match shape their conflict.

chapters.title: Cactus wins, but pays heavily
chapters.context: The physical beating matters as much as the result, building sympathy for the challenger.

chapters.title: The powerbomb on concrete
chapters.result: Vader powerbombs Cactus onto the exposed floor.
chapters.context: Foley suffered a real concussion. The later amnesia segments were fictional explanations for his absence, not descriptions of his actual condition.

chapters.title: The Texas Death Match
chapters.result: Vader defeats Cactus with Harley Race’s interference.
chapters.context: The returning challenger takes Vader into a violent endurance test, but Race helps deny him the final victory.
